audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart says 'Skill' on all seven rows while the content layer and the packet levelChart both say Sylas/Sylas/Sylas/Skill/Ekko/Ekko/Ekko. The page renders two different answers to who wins each stage.
audit.why: Sylas's Chain Lash (775 range) plus Kingslayer's on-champion heal (12s at rank 1) beats Ekko's 325-range E string before Chronobreak exists; after 6 and first item Ekko's rewind plus burst flips it.
audit.corrected: Full phases[0..2].side -> Sylas, phases[3] stays Skill, phases[4..6].side -> Ekko, matching the content win[] values already on disk.

audit.why: Spike order is right: Sylas lvl 3-5 all-in, level 6 Hijack, Ekko first item, Ekko late. Hijack cooldown numbers (80/55/30) were absent and are now used in cooldowns and dosFull[1].
audit.corrected: Added real Hijack (80s rank 1) and Chronobreak (110s rank 1) numbers to the spike advice.

audit.whatIsWrong: The matchup never named a single Sylas ability (packet defect) and never stated the decisive interaction: Hijack copies Ekko's Chronobreak.
audit.why: Hijack (R, 950 range) steals the enemy ultimate. Against Ekko that means a second rewind on Sylas's side, so the sequencing rule is that Ekko's R must be spent after Sylas commits his, not before. Also Abscond/Abduct is a dash with a chain recast (13/12/11/10/9) and Kingslayer heals off champions, which is why Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades.
audit.corrected: Named Chain Lash, Kingslayer, Abscond/Abduct, Petricite Burst and Hijack across cooldowns, enemyWin, dosFull, dontsFull and the phase whys, with real cooldowns.

audit.why: It is the field that carries real cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Rewrote with Abscond 13s->9s, Kingslayer 12s->6s, Hijack 80s, Chronobreak 110s.

edits.before: Q the wave and his toes — the return pass chunks; learn the slow zone's drag on his dodge patterns.
edits.after: Chain Lash outranges your 325 E — Q the wave from max, respect his poke, and take no extended trade.

edits.before: E blink-strike window opens: Q-E-auto is your first real trade and the third passive hit stings already.
edits.after: Kingslayer heals him off you every 12s — his level-2 lunge trade still beats your Q-E-auto string.

edits.before: W zone games begin: drop it on his retreat line BEFORE trading and the stun finds him mid-regret.
edits.after: Chain Lash is 8s at rank 3 and Petricite Burst adds chip — drop W on his line, but do not duel yet.

edits.before: Three-hit trades on cooldown — Q in, E the gap, passive proc, walk. Bank the tempo for 6.
edits.after: Even now: Q-E-passive strings trade fine if you leave before Abduct recasts. Bank the tempo for 6.

edits.before: Chronobreak online — your aggression gets a save file. Trade like the rewind exists, because it does.
edits.after: Chronobreak online and he can only Hijack it once you spend it — trade like the rewind exists.

edits.before: First item spike: the full string deletes half bars and the rewind erases the counter-argument.
edits.after: First item: the string chunks him through Kingslayer's heal, and the rewind erases his counter-kill.

edits.before: Late Ekko picks and survives: dive the carry, W the peel, and Chronobreak out of whatever they answered with.
edits.after: Late you pick and survive: dive the carry, W the peel, and Chronobreak out of the Hijack he saved.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your R Chronobreak like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Abscond/Abduct is 13s at rank 1 and only 9s maxed — that gap is your window. - Kingslayer heals every 12s early, 6s maxed. - Hijack is 80s at rank 1: bait it, then spend your 110s Chronobreak on the follow-up.

edits.before: Q through him, E the gap, passive third hit, walk out through the slow — the full string chunks and the return pass pays the exit.
edits.after: Hijack copies your Chronobreak, so spend R only after he commits his — 80s at rank 1 leaves a whiffed Hijack naked for over a minute.

edits.before: Blinking in with R down against a loaded kit — Ekko without the rewind is a mid laner doing parkour at a funeral.
edits.after: In his wave Petricite Burst chips you every auto and Kingslayer heals it straight back — at even HP that trade only goes his way.

edits.before: Sylas wins by landing Abscond / Abduct, denying your pattern, and turning your every misstep into the all-in you hadn’t budgeted.
edits.after: Sylas wins by hitting Abduct's recast into Chain Lash, healing the trade back with Kingslayer, and Hijacking the Chronobreak you saved.

edits.before: If Sylas gets a kill, the lane gets honest — give Abscond / Abduct extra room and farm it back. Two kills: stop dueling your tilt — farm with Q passes and stay relevant through W stuns and R picks.
edits.after: If Sylas gets a kill, Kingslayer's heal makes every trade unwinnable — stand outside his 400 range and farm with Q. Two kills: never facecheck his Abduct line; play for W stuns on his engage and R picks.

edits.before: Carry through insured dives — one carry per rewind cycle; your job is spending R as a weapon, not an apology.
edits.after: Carry by diving once his Hijack is spent — one carry per rewind cycle; R is the weapon, not the apology.

edits.before: Ahead, compound the tempo: string Sylas off every contact, dive the rivers insured, and rewind the audits — fed Ekko makes time a one-way argument.
edits.after: Ahead, deny him mana and Kingslayer targets: string him off every contact, take his blue side, and dive insured — a Sylas who cannot heal cannot brawl.

edits.before: Ekko's first item lets your burst and resonance procs start punishing his cooldowns.
edits.after: First item plus early Grievous Wounds cuts Kingslayer's heal and punishes his cooldowns.
